convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iBands (Bollinger Bands) indicator. Simple breakout entry with fixed SL/TP. No external libraries, no custom indicators, no grid/martingale. Standard market orders with digit adjustment logic.

derived_values.name: Adjusted SL value (pips to points conversion for 5-digit brokers)
Adjusted TP value (pips to points conversion for 5-digit brokers)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When Lots input is negative, it is treated as fixed lot size (absolute value). When Lots input is positive, it is treated as fraction of free margin to risk (e.g. Lots=0.1 means risk 10% of free margin, with the actual volume calculated from margin required per lot).

custom_logic_notes: Breakout strategy: price closing above the upper Bollinger Band triggers a buy; price closing below the lower Bollinger Band triggers a sell. Only one trade at a time (checks total positions == 0 before entry). New bar guard prevents multiple entries per bar. The lots parameter has dual meaning: negative values are fixed lots, positive values are a fraction of free margin for position sizing. Margin check is performed before order submission using OrderCalcMargin().
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward breakout strategy. Use pandas_ta or ta library for Bollinger Bands (period=20, std=2). Entry on bar close crossing above/below bands. Implement new-bar detection to prevent duplicate signals. The conditional lot sizing logic (negative=fixed, positive=margin fraction) must be replicated using broker margin calculations. Digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers should use the symbol's point value to convert pip-based SL/TP to price units. No custom indicators or external dependencies needed.
